title: Lakshya Sen Eyes Japan Masters Title in Kumamoto Final
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen is competing for a prestigious BWF title, showcasing his return to form.
summary: Lakshya Sen is set to compete in the Japan Masters 2026 men's singles final against Koki Watanabe, aiming for his second consecutive BWF tour title.

title: Lakshya Sen Makes History, First Indian in Japan Masters Final
indian_angle: Lakshya Sen's performance marks a historic moment as he becomes the first Indian to reach the Japan Masters summit clash.
summary: Lakshya Sen defeated Alwi Farhan to secure his spot in the Japan Masters 2026 final, continuing his strong run after winning the HYLO Open.

title: BAI Elections Scheduled for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The upcoming elections will determine the leadership of the Badminton Association of India, impacting the future direction of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced that its forthcoming elections will be held on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati.

title: Senior National Badminton Championships Confirmed for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: This announcement confirms the venue and dates for India's premier domestic badminton tournament, where top national talent will compete.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17 to 24.

title: National Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Underway
indian_angle: India's promising junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in preparation for the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the NCE, Guwahati, to prepare Indian players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
